mission: Design a fixed-wing survey drone for topographic mapping and land surveying. The drone should carry a 400g multispectral camera, have at least 60 minutes of flight time, cover 200+ hectares per flight, and cruise at 15-20 m/s. It needs to be hand-launchable and have a safe belly-landing capability. Autonomous flight with pre-programmed survey patterns is essential. Must work in European airspace compliant with EASA regulations. Budget is €4000.
